text:
alana: quick sync  we keep onboarding DPs and then scope grows mid-sprint. Can we lock a small set of acceptance gates + incentive options so expectations are clear?
fred: yes. propose 4 acceptance gates: intake score, sample-prompts ok, infra risk <= 3, and monitoring live.
jing: add a required "partner commitment" checkbox: willing to join 2 feedback sessions and share labeled examples or credits for evaluation. that correlates with success.
marc: for incentives, we should standardize: credits tier, co-marketing, or product credits + engineering timebox. make a table so sales can pick.
ops-bot: automation idea: intake form -> scoring lambda -> attach tags: escrow_needed, infra_risk_high, on_prem.
alana: gating SLA idea: ack within 24h, score + route within 3 business days, final yes/no in 7 business days unless heavy path.
fred: scoring sketch:
```
# small pseudo score
score = 0
if sample_prompts_provided == 'yes': score += 1
if infra_changes == 'no': score += 2
if data_sensitivity == 'high': score -= 2
if target_qps >= 200: score -= 1
# score >=3 -> quick-path, 1-2 -> standard beta, <=0 -> heavy/pilot
```
jing: we should combine score with a binary commitment flag: if commitment == false -> deprioritize for deep integration.
marc: launch levels: quick-path (2 wks), standard beta (4-6 wks), pilot (spec + SLA + 6-12 wks). each level has explicit deliverables.
alana: quick-path deliverables: owner, sample prompts validated, smoke tests, docs snippet, monitoring panel. Standard adds 1 pilot customer, use-case eval, and cost estimate. Pilot adds SLA doc, data MOU, capacity plan.
fred: define monitoring panel: prompt sampling (1%), latency p95, token cost/1k, human pass rate on core prompts. add alert if pass rate drops >10% or cost increases >30%.
jing: evaluation: we run a 14-day quality check window post-launch: daily sampled pass rate + a partner CSAT at day 14. if pass_rate < threshold -> rollback plan engaged.
marc: rollback plan short: revert to previous model alias or route to hosted fallback. include brief comms template for partners.
alana: outreach template (short):
```
Hi {name},
Thanks for signing up as a design partner for {feature}. Quick ask: 1) share 20-100 sample prompts (or check "no sample"), 2) expected peak qps, 3) data residency, 4) willingness to join 2 feedback sessions.
We will score within 48h and propose a path.
Best, Redwood DP team
```
fred: add NDA link option and a box for "preferred incentive" (credits/co-marketing/timebox).
ops-bot: note: any request with on-prem or VPC -> tag security & legal; pause auto-assign until clearance.
jing: metrics table (to publish internally): acceptance-to-decision time, % of DPs providing prompts, average scope churn per DP, % launches with monitoring live at go. target: decision <72h, prompts provided >70%, scope churn <15%.
marc: roll policy for mid-sprint asks: if request changes scope after commit, requires a re-score and PM+ENG sign-off. do not accept scope creep inside 2-week sprints without emergency triage.
alana: ops next steps: (1) intake form fields + commit checkbox, (2) scoring lambda, (3) auto-tags for security/legal, (4) one-page rollback + comms templates. timeline: 10 business days for MVP?
fred: dev work minimal. can do form + lambda + mock ticket in 8 days. I'll carve out time.
jing: i'll draft the acceptance criteria and the CSAT template. marc will own incentive templates and outreach copy.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled in 6 business days in #product.
alana: we'll pilot with 2 internal teams, then invite 2 external DPs. goal: reduce scope surprises and make launches measurable. thanks all.
